boundary: Actual Solid ambient UI, simulated camera/models/native responses. Does not measure physical webcam recognition.

results.flow: Face ID and a persistent key-to-unlock hint are visible before scanning
Camera readiness starts as soon as enrolled ambient becomes visible, before unlock input
First good frame unlocks without waiting for a second frame
A clear mismatch finishes promptly with one counted final check
PIN is available while scanning and cancels a late face result
Hiding a warm ambient page stops the camera and discards an in-flight scan
A reused warm page unlocks again after cancellation
All five scenes and four clocks render; reduced motion stops canvas animation
Hidden prewarm loads models without the webcam; keep-ready opens only when shown and stops on hide
